page.overview:
Who is Assistant Director?

The Assistant Director appeared briefly in the 1995 film Mortal Kombat. He was working on the set of Johnny Cage's latest movie before his entry into the Mortal Kombat Tournament.

After Cage left the set as he was upset by an actor who made a mistakes and argued with the Director, the Assistant Director came to Cage, telling him someone was waiting to see him. Cage asked who the man was as he did not want to see the press, while the Assistant Director thought the man could not be one but he was not sure.
